visualReview.visualMethod: 306 paired-content cards reviewed in 26 contact sheets; 73 adjusted cards reviewed again in 7 sheets, followed by detail rechecks. 84 changed dependent cards reviewed in 7 sheets; 10 collateral recipe repairs and the aid/kit detail were rechecked separately.

regression.note: The bundled Chromium was absent; the Chrome cases were rerun successfully with the installed Google Chrome. The final build differs in trailing whitespace in fix.svg only; source comparison verified unchanged SVG geometry and text.
